status: software reference interface for later hardware alignment
architecture: FPGA range compression and SAR RDA
K3 image adapter and FP16 inference
transport: to be selected with the existing hardware team

metadata_required.first_chirp_timestamp_ns: int64 with declared clock_domain and synchronization status
metadata_required.algorithm: SAR_RDA or RANGE_DOPPLER; never silently interchange
metadata_required.pixel_encoding: RGB8_READY_FOR_MODEL, POWER_F32_LE or fixed-point format with explicit scale
metadata_required.coordinate_axes: For SAR: along-track and broadside range in metres, origin and spacing; for RD: beat range and Doppler Hz
metadata_required.orientation: origin corner, axis directions and rotation
metadata_required.valid_region: image support or mask with geometry
metadata_required.intensity_mapping_id: versioned log compression, dB limits, palette and normalization reference
metadata_required.acquisition: ADC count, chirp count, per-chirp time schedule, TX/RX, sample rate, chirp slope, frequency reference
metadata_required.motion: trajectory or speed, geometry reference and calibration version used for imaging
metadata_required.integrity: payload size and checksum; dropped or incomplete aperture flag

initial_adapter: Use existing 640 letterbox RGB/255 inference preprocessing. Validate image mapping against existing SAR model inputs before applying detector to new FPGA image products.
software_reference: optimization_v2/app/compare_rda_bp.py provides RDA and RCMC with retained complex output. It is not RTL or synthesized FPGA firmware.
